text:
Marco: Heads up 1: AcmeHealth POC approved. Procurement sent a PO template + a few asks: BYOK/HSM language in the DPA, explicit VPC peering on the order form, and they want invoice to billing@acmehealth.com. They also flagged Net60 by default in their PO.

Marco: Looping in @Sofia @Naveen @Aisha to confirm who will handle the DPA redline and the signature flow.

Naveen (Procurement): We need the signed PDF only (their AP system can't ingest DocuSign envelope metadata). They require PO number on invoice and a completed vendor W-9. Also: will Redwood accept Net30 instead of Net60 if we commit to earlier milestone-based billing?

Sofia (Legal): Quick checks:
- Are they insisting on full customer-held keys (no copy retained) or allowing split custody?
- Indemnity/data processing: they marked a box asking for subprocessor list and standard liability caps.
If they want customer-only key custody, we need the BYOK addendum plus a statement that Redwood will not have access to plaintext. Drafting two short options now.

Aisha (Solutions): For the order form, propose this snippet under network/security:
```
Deployment: Private (VPC) – customer-managed VPC peering or site-to-site VPN
KMS: BYOK supported; customer-managed HSM (cloud or on-prem). If on-prem HSM required, professional services required for deployment.
Logging: CloudTrail + audit log export to customer S3
```
Also confirm whether Acme wants managed backups to our encrypted bucket or will retain backups in their own S3.

Evan (Eng): Technical note: we can support cloud HSM (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Key Vault HSM) without PS. On-prem HSM will require an onsite integration window and a one-time services fee. We need to know FIPS level (140-2 vs 140-3) for compatibility testing.

SalesOps Bot: DocuSign attempt failed: "recipient phone authentication required but not provided". Envelope paused.

Marco: Ugh. Procurement asked to be able to countersign via one person (procurement@acmehealth.com) but their security team has phone-auth policy. Can we set phone auth on our side?

SalesOps Bot: We can set phone auth, but the DocuSign API expects the phone number in E.164 format on the recipient. Please provide the number or opt for manual signed PDF.

Naveen (Procurement): I can request a low-friction path: they can provide a PDF signed by procurement and legal separately. That's their preference if DocuSign keeps failing.

Sofia (Legal): Drafting DPA redline now. Two variants: (A) Customer-managed KMS (no key material stored by Redwood) OR (B) Split custody with envelope-wrapped KEK stored by customer and DEKs handled by Redwood. Also adding a short SLA exception clause: Acme requests 99.95% uptime; we will offer 99.9% committed with a negotiated credit table and an option to purchase the 99.95 SLA at extra cost.

Aisha (Solutions): For SOW: add line items for "HSM integration (cloud) - included" and "HSM on-prem integration - one-time PS fee $12k". Also add a flag for "backup retention managed by customer - yes/no".

Marco: Action items:
- @Sofia: upload the DPA redline (both variants) by EOD PT
- @Aisha: update order form with VPC + KMS snippet and add PS line item for on-prem HSM
- @Naveen: confirm billing email + whether they can provide phone number for DocuSign auth or will send signed PDFs
- @Evan: confirm FIPS compatibility and estimate PS hours if on-prem HSM
- @SalesOps Bot: attempt DocuSign with phone auth once number provided, else prepare manual envelope ID env-1723501234-manual

Naveen (Procurement): Billing email confirmed: billing@acmehealth.com. AP asked we attach vendor tax form and enter PO# AH-PO-2024-0912 on invoice. I'll ask for phone contact for procurement.

Evan (Eng): FIPS 140-2 supported on our current cloud HSM path; 140-3 requires a quick firmware check on the vendor HSM. PS estimate for on-prem is 24-40 hours depending on connectivity.

Sofia (Legal): Uploaded redline: filename `acme_dpa_redline_1723501234.pdf`. Key paragraph preview:
```
Customer Key Custody: Customer shall maintain sole possession of key material in their approved HSM/KMS. Redwood shall not persist key material. Access to logs and attestations will be provided on request. If split custody is required, parties will execute the Key Custody Addendum.
```
Also added SLA exception language: customer requested 99.95; Redwood base 99.9 with optional upgrade.

Marco: Great. If we get the signed PDF + W-9 and PO# we can process onboarding. Trying to avoid finance escalations.

SalesOps Bot: Manual envelope placeholder created: env-1723501234-manual. Upload link: /envelopes/env-1723501234-manual.

Aisha (Solutions): FYI: if they want backups in their S3, we need IAM role ARN to set write permissions. Please collect that.

Naveen (Procurement): I'll push for signed PDFs tonight and confirm whether they will accept Net30 for milestone billing.

Marco: Thanks team 44d aiming to close countersign tomorrow AM. Ping me if you need approvals.
